stem_book: In given reaction 1 mole of each reactant is present initially. If Kc is 16 at 50 °C then what will be equilibrium concentration of both products? SO₃(g) + NO(g) → NO₂(g) + SO₂(g) (a) 0.4 M, 0.4 M (b) 0.6 M, 0.6 M (c) 1.6 M, 1.6 M (d) 1.4 M, 1.4 M
reason: No printed option correct: 1 mol each (1 L) gives x²/(1−x)² = 16 → x = 0.8 M; key (c) 1.6 M needs 2 mol each initially.
